name: Caddy's Delight Virtual Golf Lounge
address: 1158 W 3rd Avenue, Suite B, Columbus, OH 43212

booking.howItWorks: Book golf bays online through the website's booking link or call 614-725-4209. For parties and private events, send the Event/Party Inquiry form on the website. Mondays are reserved for private events.

packages.name: Virtual golf bay (hourly)
packages.description: Simulator bay rental priced per bay per hour, one-hour minimum. Summer rates: Tue-Thu and Sun $25/hour, Fri-Sat $45/hour. About 40 virtual courses.

addOns.name: Club rental
addOns.description: Per session. Or bring your own clubs, washed and ready to go.

faq.q: Can I bring my own clubs?
faq.a: Yes, bring your own clubs "washed and ready to go," or rent clubs for $10 per session.

faq.q: Is there a minimum booking time?
faq.a: Yes. Bays are priced per hour with a one-hour minimum.
Mondays are closed to the public and reserved for private events.

faq.q: How do I book a party or private event?
faq.a: Fill in the Event/Party Inquiry form on our website.

faq.q: Do you serve food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes. We have a full restaurant, patio and bar & grill with a locally sourced menu, craft beers, cocktails and frozen drinks. Virtual Golf and the Patio Bar & Grill share the same hours.
